choose.title: Choose format
choose.body: SuperDoc detects the input and enables the formats the backend supports.

download.title: Download result
download.body: Processing runs as a real job, then unlocks your download when it is ready.

private.title: Private by default
private.body: Anonymous files are short-lived. Saved files require your account.

fast.title: Fast jobs
fast.body: Upload, processing, and download progress stay visible.

browser.title: Browser based
browser.body: Use it on desktop or mobile without installing an app.

honest.title: Honest targets
honest.body: Unsupported formats stay visible but disabled until the backend supports them.

free.a: Yes. Core conversion works without an account. Accounts are only needed for saved files.

unsupported.a: Unavailable targets remain visible but disabled for the selected file. Enabled actions come from the deployed operation catalog.

edit.a: Yes. When the catalog exposes a browser editor for the selected file, the Edit action appears next to the converter.

routes.q: Do routes and saved files still work?
routes.a: Yes. Uploads, job polling, editor routing, authentication, and dashboard files use the existing backend flow.

support.title: Support SuperDoc without locking the core product.
support.intro: Core conversions stay free. Support helps fund the heavier multimedia pipeline and keeps the free document surface sustainable.
support.documentsFreeBody: PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, image, and spreadsheet tools stay free for normal use. Credits are not needed for the document workbench.
support.creditsBody: Registered users will get one multimedia run per day for free. Credits only matter when you want extra audio, transcription, subtitle, or future video processing.
support.packHint: Credits unlock multimedia tools — amounts TBD.
support.signInBody: Credit purchases are attached to your account so the balance can be reused later.
support.signInActivity: Recent purchases will appear here after you sign in.
support.checkoutSuccess: Payment received. Your credit balance should refresh shortly.
support.checkoutCancelled: Checkout was cancelled. No credits were added.
support.loadFailed: Could not load your credit balance.
support.card1Body: PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, image, and spreadsheet conversions remain on the document workbench.
support.card2Body: Multimedia tools, transcription, subtitle flows, and future container-backed processing.
support.card3Body: Use Ko-fi if you want to help now. No recurring commitment is required.
